function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the Pandora Papers public reporting concerning King Abdullah II of Jordan's alleged offshore property network. Use only evidence returned by the benchmark tools and report the exact source IDs they provide for every supported point. Build a comprehensive, source-grounded inventory of: (1) identified shell companies and the exact names used; (2) beneficial-ownership, director, trustee, control, or other relationship links, naming people or entities only when the evidence explicitly supports them; (3) advisers, lawyers, accountants, banks, agents, and intermediaries; (4) relevant jurisdictions; (5) transactions, incorporation events, ownership transfers, legal structures, or stated purposes; and (6) luxury real-estate locations and properties. For every item, distinguish directly documented facts from allegations, journalistic characterization or assessment, inference, disputed accounts, denials, and unresolved uncertainty. Capture relevant responses from the king, his representatives, companies, governments, or other parties, and identify contradictions or gaps. Do not supplement with general knowledge, unstated assumptions, or facts lacking tool-returned evidence. Return a readable evidence matrix or structured notes with precise source IDs attached to each assertion, plus a list of unsupported or uncertain points that must be omitted or explicitly labeled uncertain in the final report."}
function.name: ConductResearch
